business: SEGMENT: real estate agents, St. Louis
prompt_text: Who is the best real estate agent in St. Louis MO to sell my house?
competitors_mentioned: Krista Hartmann’s team at RE/MAX Results
engine_stated_criteria: seller-side sales in your neighborhood and price range
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” agent for every St. Louis home—the right fit depends on your neighborhood, price range, and how much hands-on support you want. Based on the available directory results, **Krista Hartmann’s team at RE/MAX Results** is one strong candidate to interview: Zillow lists 5.0 stars from 164 reviews and 212 team sales in the past 12 months. **Dan Brassil at RedKey Realty** is another: 5.0 stars from 319 reviews and 61 sales in the past 12 months.

Those are platform-reported figures, not a guarantee of results, and team sales may include transactions where the lead agent wasn’t personally involved. Before choosing, ask each agent for recent **seller-side sales in your neighborhood and price range**, their suggested list price and supporting comparable sales, marketing plan, who will handle showings and negotiations, and the full commission and cancellation terms. Interview at least two or three agents.

If you share your neighborhood or ZIP code, approximate home value, and whether it’s a condo or single-family home, I can help narrow down what to look for.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
